label: There is no per se causal loop: no…, from A middle cause efficiently causes that of… and 3 more
description: Derived, not a transcription: the conclusion is not the consequent of any premise, and the countermodels in the Comparator config show that each premise is needed. The companion proof, independently registered as NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-ACTUALIZATION with controls EXISTENTIAL-SELF-ACTUALIZATION-CONTROLS, separately excludes self-actualization of a bearer's own existence: an occurring productive act presupposes the bearer as prior, while its productive relation makes the act prior to the bearer's existence, contradicting transitive irreflexive priority. Two omission controls preserve the two-way edges after removing transitivity or irreflexivity; a positive control admits an act actualizing the existence of a different being under all premises. This is an analyst conditional about mixed existence-fact/act priority, not Aquinas' claim about an arbitrary source-free time loop. All metaphysical application premises remain open; no premise discharge; its refutes relation REL-PER-SE-CAUSAL-LOOP-IMPOSSIBLE-REFUTES does not count while those premises are open (#391, #999).
